# Ground-truth byte layouts for the ESP-NOW wire structs.
#
# Generated by tools/golden/gen_golden.cpp, which carries the enow_text_msg_t
# and enow_admin_msg_t typedefs verbatim from the firmware's src/WiFiOps.h and
# lets a real C++ compiler lay them out.
#
# Format: <name> <length> <hex>.  Lines starting with # are ignored, so output
# from tools/espnow-sniffer can be pasted in unedited to turn frames captured
# off the air into permanent regression tests.
heartbeat 212 
text_wifi 212 
text_ble 212 
core_request 212 
admin 10 454e4f57050702051017

# --- Frames captured off real hardware, 2026-09-05 ---------------------------
# ESP32-C5 node (firmware v2.3.2) paired with a C5 wardriver core, sniffed by a
# C6 on channel 6. Plaintext, broadcast to FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF, RSSI about -40.
# Heartbeat counters 147-151 are a node roughly twelve minutes into its run,
# which is why every observation here is BLE: nearby access points had long
# since been absorbed into the node's 200-entry dedup ring.
